name: bandit.r033_registered_smoke_samelevel_dedup_control_mcw
description: R-033 falsifying control for the retained OMT divergence. It keeps the active same-level smokebomb centered in one OMT; if the observer still creates a second lead at the next cadence, production identity/dedup is implicated. Fixture registration and activation are zero credit.

proof_gates.label: R-033 stable-OMT control reaches one current source-bound live session

steps.label: operate_r033_registered_smoke_samelevel_dedup_control
steps.objective: Bind the singleton idle site/member 18 and the centered active same-level smoke source. At the first cadence retain a created smoke lead; at the second cadence retain the same source OMT and exact lead identity/count/hash. A second lead under this centered control falsifies the natural-spread explanation.
proof_targets: singleton registered idle site and observer identity
same-level solid-floor source centered in the camp OMT
first source-bound smoke scan and created lead
second source-bound smoke scan and unchanged/dedup receipt
sound/light absence and exact lead count/hash at both boundaries
authority: advertised native actions and worker-chosen bounded waits
invariants: registration and item activation are zero-credit
source remains unchanged between the two cadences
do not treat unrelated presentation as callback evidence

evidence_contract.claim: one centered-OMT source-bound control distinguishes natural smoke spread from production smoke identity/dedup failure
evidence_contract.failure_rule: a missing binding, missing first callback, OMT boundary crossing, or identity-changing second read leaves the control unresolved rather than proving a production defect
